school: Alexander Hamilton High School, Los Angeles CA
method: Colour photos: Wikimedia Commons (2023, CC BY-SA 4.0 / GFDL) for Brown Hall and Pattiz Concert Hall, one news og:image for the brick pylon; 1930s LAUSD archive photos (monochrome) for bonds, coursing, tile roofs and the arcades. Swatches are median LINEAR RGB (refs.py swatch) scaled against sunlit cast stone (taken as 0.60). Brick: Flemish bond with over-burnt (clinker) headers is plain in page_28c1fbfbd7.jpg and commons_55eea9d40d.jpg; standard 8 x 2 1/4 in units, 3 courses = 8 in.

red-orange stretchers.note: estimated from the wall mean with one third dark headers and 15% cream mortar
